title: Gripper 5: Stocking shelves (MuJoCo)
description: Gripper 4's soft fingers, now with pointy tips, on a 6-DOF end-effector in front of two grocery shelf units: take groceries out of the crates on the floor and stock the empty places on the shelves. Steer it by dragging the gripper with the mouse or a finger, with its gizmo, the keyboard or the sliders. MuJoCo, faster than real time.
